title: Retry with backoff
description:
Retry a flaky call with exponential backoff and jitter.

```
attempt 1 failed (503), waiting 0.50 s
attempt 2 failed (503), waiting 1.00 s
attempt 3 succeeded: {'ok': True}
```
hints: `except ApiError as e: if e.status not in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) or n == attempts: raise` (lesson 3.03).
Full jitter is `random.uniform(0, delay)`; it spreads many clients out so they do not all retry at the same moment.
requirements: `retry(call, attempts=5, base=0.5, cap=8)` waits `min(cap, base * 2 ** (n - 1))` seconds, with "full jitter" (a random time from 0 to that) when `jitter=True`.
Retry only on errors marked as retryable; raise others straight away.
Inject `sleep` and `random` so the example can run instantly.
stretch: Respect a `Retry-After` value on the error instead of your own delay.
